title: Orders & Delivery
summary: Track an order, report an order issue, or get help with delivery.

articles.title: How can I check my order status?
articles.content: Use the Support Assistant and provide the order ID to check the latest order status.

articles.title: What if there is a delivery issue?
articles.content: Provide the order ID and describe the delivery problem. Support can record the issue and assist with next steps.

articles.title: Can I get help with a delayed order?
articles.content: Provide the order ID and explain that the order is delayed. The Support Assistant can check the available order information.

title: Returns & Refunds
summary: Get help with returns, refund requests, and refund status.

articles.title: How do I request a refund?
articles.content: Use the Support Assistant to request a refund. The order must be verified before the refund request can be created.

articles.title: How can I check my refund status?
articles.content: Provide the order ID or refund information to check the current refund status.

articles.title: What if the refund amount is incorrect?
articles.content: The Support Assistant verifies the transaction amount before creating a refund request.

title: Payments
summary: Resolve payment-related issues or get help with a payment problem.

articles.title: What if my payment has a problem?
articles.content: Provide the related order ID, if available, and describe what happened. A support ticket can be created for the issue.

articles.title: What information is needed for a payment issue?
articles.content: The order ID and a brief description of the payment problem help support investigate the issue.

articles.title: Can I get human help with a payment issue?
articles.content: Yes. The Support Assistant can create a support ticket for a payment issue so that a human representative can assist.

title: Account & Login
summary: Manage account issues, login problems, and password resets.

articles.title: I cannot access my account
articles.content: Provide the customer ID, email, or phone number and describe the account issue. Support can record the issue for assistance.

articles.title: How do I reset my password?
articles.content: Use the Support Assistant to start the password-reset process. A secure reset link can be provided when the customer identity is verified.

articles.title: What if my account is locked?
articles.content: Provide the customer details and explain that the account is locked. The Support Assistant can record the account issue for support.

title: Complaints & Issues
summary: Raise a complaint or report a problem that needs attention.

articles.title: How do I raise a complaint?
articles.content: Use the Support Assistant and choose to make a complaint. Provide the customer details and describe the complaint.

articles.title: How can I escalate an issue?
articles.content: Describe the issue and explain why it needs escalation. The Support Assistant can create an escalation record.

articles.title: Can I check my complaint status?
articles.content: Provide the complaint ID to check the current complaint status.

title: Contact Support
summary: Need further assistance? Our support assistant can help with your request.

articles.title: How can I contact support?
articles.content: Open the Support Assistant using the floating support button or the Open Support button.

articles.title: What can the Support Assistant help with?
articles.content: The Support Assistant can answer support questions, check records, create tickets, handle refund requests, record complaints, and create escalations.

articles.title: When should I request human assistance?
articles.content: If an issue requires human attention, the Support Assistant can create a support ticket or escalation where appropriate.
